text:
incident-bot: Pager alert: HIGH 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings in eu-west -> routing fallback loop suspected, pinned version mismatch.
ops-bot: @leeia you're oncall — can you grab?
leeia (oncall): grabbing. seeing 5xx spike ~10% p50 latency up. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/inc/xyz
sanjay (infra): looks like requests are being routed to variant "instruct-v2" which doesn't support embeddings input. fallback policy is set to "variant_compatible" but alias maps are stale.
maya (sre): confirming logs: `ValidationError: model does not support embeddings` repeated. sample: ```2024-11-03T18:02:01Z ERROR req=abcd validation: incompatible-variant instruct-v2 for route embeddings``` 
leeia (oncall): ok——pin check: `GET /configs/aliases/embeddings-prod` returns `pinned_version: v2024-11-03-09` which was supposed to be a gen->embed safe pin but it's actually an instruct build. I think a deploy flipped a build tag.
diana (prod): I deployed an alias change as part of canary earlier, I reverted the mapping but it may not have propagated to eu-west. tagging @ops-bot to force sync.
ops-bot: Kicking alias sync job -> job id job-7721. will report when done.
julia (cs): customers seeing "500 internal server error" for similarity search calls — CS triaging. volume: ~120k requests/min across accounts, ~8% failing.
tom (support): piling a customer impact list, will DM high-touch accounts and link to status page.
maya (sre): mitigation plan:
1) temporarily remove fallback to incompatible variants (set fallback_policy=fail) for embeddings route in eu-west
2) rollback alias pin to previous known-good version `v2024-10-29-02`
3) re-run alias sync and monitor for 5xx
leeia (oncall): executing step1 now: `PATCH /routes/embeddings-prod { "fallback_policy":"fail" }` -> 200
ops-bot: alias sync job job-7721 completed: 145 aliases reconciled, eu-west corrected
sanjay (infra): triggering rollback pin: `POST /configs/aliases/embeddings-prod/pin?version=v2024-10-29-02` -> accepted
maya (sre): monitoring: 5xx dropped from 8% -> 0.6% in ~3m. latency P50 back to baseline.
leeia (oncall): keeping fallback_policy=fail for 30m, will schedule safe re-enable with canary.
diana (prod): patch that caused the incorrect pin was a coordinate with model onboarding script. I'll freeze auto-pins and open PR to add validation to ensure variant capability matches route type.
julia (cs): alert customers updated, internal status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1725556666
tom (support): collecting impacted customers for postmortem.
ops-bot: incident annotated: severity=SEV2, impact=embeddings 5xx across eu-west, start=1725556666, mitigated=1725556860
leeia (oncall): handing off to maya for watch. @maya take over — I'm out for the day.
maya (sre): ack. will watch 1hr then start postmortem doc. assigning tags: routing, pin, fallback-policy, region-eu-west
incident-bot: runbook note appended: ensure alias sync completes before enabling fallback; add canary for cross-region pin rollouts.
leeia (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup:
